build.summary:
I built structural-transseptal-hands-on. The TEER and LAAO labs no longer use the fossa point-picker: the learner now does the transseptal puncture by hand.

- **Engine:** new file src/simulation/transseptal.ts. FossaPoint, septalHeightCm, assessTransseptal and the TEER height target moved here unchanged, and teer.ts re-exports them. The learner aligns the arrow and side arm and sets the arrow on a clock face (an unaligned arrow points the tip more anterior than it reads). The pull-down from the SVC gives two jumps, atrial ectopics at the superior rim and tenting. Pulling too far drops the tip into the IVC, and the wire must go back to the SVC.
- **Moving the tent:** rotation alone is stored as torque and does not move the contact point. A slight withdrawal releases it, so clockwise with withdrawal moves the tent posterior and withdrawal alone moves it inferior. The bicaval, short-axis and four-chamber views show the tent and the measured height.
- **Crossing:** needle, RF or sharp wire. Four confirmations (TOE, aspiration, tip pressure, contrast); the learner names the pressure trace (LA, RA or aortic) and the stage never labels it. Advancing the dilator without all four confirmations, or into the aorta, is critical, and the aorta causes haemopericardium. Then sheath, needle removal with hub low and aspiration (otherwise air), flush, wire to the left superior pulmonary vein.
- **Heparin and ACT:** the ACT is computed from the doses with the pharmacology.ts constants. A low ACT is flagged once the left atrium is entered.
- **Complication branches:** aortic puncture (withdraw nothing, call the surgeon); a vagal reflex that settles within minutes with no effusion; air embolism with ST elevation that persists; delayed tamponade after a posterior exit, which declares itself only after the catheters come out unless a wire is left across and watched; a thick septum that overshoots if forced; a sheath that will not follow the dilator, which needs a pulmonary-vein wire before escalating; a floppy septum that loses height. There are also scoring and decision-ledger functions.
- **Values:** every dose, target and waveform rule cites the module lessons ts-setup and ts-cross. Geometry, timing and haemodynamic sizes are labelled MODEL PARAMETER in the code.
- **UI:** new src/ui/structural/TransseptalStage.tsx (views, controls, drill debrief). The screen shows only what an operator would see; the fossa map with its target zone and the site assessment appear only with "Guided aids" on, never in exams. FossaPicker.tsx now exports its three TOE views and has a map-only mode for that aid.
- **TEER and LAAO labs:** both use the stage. The secured crossing point is scored by assessTransseptal, scoreTeer and scoreLaao exactly as before; the puncture's decisions go to the run ledger and its critical errors are added to the logbook count. TeerLab also runs the 7 ts-* presets as drills: they open at the transseptal step, end with catheter removal and recovery, and log the drill's own score. They can be chosen from the TEER scenario menu.
- **Tips and launch:** structuralTips.ts gives the stage its tip context (access with [host, 'transseptal'], position once the tip is on the fossa, complication once one has shown itself). It adds low-act, air and tamponade to `raises`. New transseptal.launch.ts declares the presets ts-standard, ts-thick-septum, ts-floppy-septum, ts-aortic-puncture, ts-vagal, ts-delayed-tamponade and ts-pacing-lead under both transseptal lessons; ts-floppy-septum is also linked to the TEER flail case.

**Two existing tests now fail** because the plan requires the wider `raises`. Both are in the dependency's test files, which I may not edit; the fixes are listed under outOfScope.

build.notes:
The snapshot is at datasets/tmp/wp-snapshots/structural-transseptal-hands-on/, with .started, holding the 5 listed files that existed before (teer.ts, FossaPicker.tsx, TeerLab.tsx, LaaoLab.tsx, structuralTips.ts). The other 4 listed files are new. No file outside the list was edited apart from the new test file. Scratch scripts are in the session scratchpad.

Design choices to review:
- **Rotation as stored torque:** this is how "rotation alone does not move the tent" is modelled. The turn is released in proportion to a withdrawal of up to 2 mm, so the order turn-then-pull and a combined `move` action behave the same.
- **Dilated-root preset:** ts-aortic-puncture moves the aortic threshold to fossa ap −0.3. An arrow at 5 o'clock enters the aorta, while 5:30 or a corrective clockwise turn plus pull avoids it.
- **Large-atrium preset:** ts-delayed-tamponade moves the posterior-exit threshold to −0.3, so a usual posterior TEER site exits and only the wire-and-watch strategy catches it on the table.
- **Low ACT:** low-act is raised only after the left atrium is entered, from a measured ACT below 250 s or from less than 70 U/kg given with no in-range ACT.
- **Logbook count:** in hosted TEER and LAAO runs the puncture's critical errors are added to `criticalErrors` (TEER and LAAO scores are unchanged).

Not done:
- The large-atrium needle-curve variant in hb-mitral-tricuspid-laa#0 is not one of the plan's seven presets, so it was not built.
- PMC and the septal occluder are supported as hosts in the engine and tip context, but have no lab yet.
- No browser check, as instructed.

review.verdict:
Not ready to close yet. Most of the package is built well, but two existing tests now fail, every practice link to a ts-* drill opens the wrong screen, and the live TOE views mislead after an aortic crossing.

Checks I ran:
- Typecheck (`npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit`) is clean.
- The package's two test files pass (36 tests).
- teer, laao, reachability, content, practiceIndex and tips tests pass.
- structuralTips.test.ts and structuralTips.scenario.test.ts each fail once, as the builder reported.

Diffs against the snapshot:
- teer.ts only moved the transseptal code and re-exports it. The moved code is byte-identical, and the golden pre-move results match.
- structuralTips.ts adds the transseptal context and widens `raises`. The TAVI behaviour is unchanged.
- No shared engine (pharmacology, patientEvents) was edited.
- The other src/ files changed since .started all belong to the two packages running alongside: diag-lab-drugs (drugs, DrugsTab, labTeam, TableView, diagDrugs) and pci-bench-bifurcation (bifurcation files, technique/steps).

What is implemented as designed:
- **Pull-down:** two jumps, ectopics at the superior rim, slip into the IVC and a repeat from the SVC.
- **Moving the tent:** rotation is stored as torque and released by a slight withdrawal, which meets the acceptance criterion.
- **Crossing:** the four confirmations, and the learner names the trace.
- **Aorta:** the dilator into the aorta gives haemopericardium, then tamponade.
- **Vagal reflex:** resolves with no effusion.
- **Delayed tamponade:** appears only after the catheters come out, with a wire-and-watch path.
- **Thick, floppy and resistant septa:** all modelled.
- **Heparin:** the ACT comes from pharmacology.ts constants.
- **Presets and tip context:** all seven presets exist, and the tip context matches the plan.
- **Sources:** numbers cite the ts-setup and ts-cross lessons or are labelled MODEL PARAMETER.
- **UI:** Clinical Graphite classes and British English. Nothing runs per frame.

The tip test proves the low-act and air tips appear, and that the two waiting.ts entries become satisfiable.

findings.where: src/ui/structural/TransseptalStage.tsx TransseptalViews lines 95-101; src/simulation/transseptal.ts cross() line 962
findings.problem: After a crossing into the aorta, the live TOE views show a successful septal crossing. cross() sets tentMm = 0 for every crossing, and the views get crossed={across}, so the bicaval and short-axis views drop the tent and draw the needle going straight up into the 'LA' label. The TOE check and the log say the opposite ('the tent has not released into it, and the tip lies towards the aortic root'). The live image misleads the learner into reading the left atrium. I confirmed tentMm 0 with needle 'aorta' by script.
findings.fix: In cross(), set tentMm = 0 only when needle === 'la'; for the aorta keep the current tent. In TransseptalViews pass `crossed={across && s.needle === "la"}` to BicavalView and ShortAxisView. When s.needle === "aorta", keep the tent and add a needle line in ShortAxisView from (x, y0 - h*0.7) towards the Ao circle, through a new prop such as `towardsAorta`. Add a render test: the aortic state draws no 'crossed' needle into the LA.

findings.where: src/ui/structural/LaaoLab.tsx abandonAtPuncture and debrief/finish effect (lines ~250-260, 190-206); src/ui/structural/TeerLab.tsx endPuncture and the non-drill debrief
findings.problem: In hosted TEER and LAAO runs, the puncture's outcome never reaches the learner. Its critical errors (e.g. 'Dilator advanced without the four confirmations.') are only added to criticalErrors, and no debrief shows them or the scoreTransseptal deductions. When the procedure is abandoned (surgeon called after an aortic puncture), both labs open their device debrief. LAAO then scores and logs `devices: ['27 mm plug occluder']` for a device never implanted, records the 'release-criteria' decision and shows a 'Released device' panel. TEER shows 'No device implanted' and its MR risks for a valve never treated.
findings.fix: Keep the step as 'debrief' and add `const abandoned = tsState.stage === "abandoned"`. When abandoned, render `<TransseptalDebrief state={tsState} score={scoreTransseptal(tsState, ts)} />` in place of the device debrief. Log r.finish with that score, `passed: false`, `criticalErrors: tsState.critical.length + (ts?.danger ? 1 : 0)` and `devices: []`, and skip the device decisions. In non-abandoned hosted debriefs, add a 'Transseptal puncture' Panel showing scoreTransseptal(tsState, ts).deductions and tsState.critical.

findings.problem: The tip-pressure trace is drawn only after the 'pressure' check, which is allowed only once the needle has crossed. The right atrial trace (a dominant) is therefore never shown, and 'Right atrial' can never be the correct reading. The design and the lesson (ts-cross 'Read the waveform': a small rise in mean pressure as the needle crosses, and the RA-versus-LA contrast) depend on seeing the trace change on crossing.
findings.fix: Draw TipPressure from the moment the tip is on the fossa (`s.zone === "fossa" || s.crossedAt`) with traceKind(s), which already returns 'ra' there. Keep the 'pressure' check and the learner's naming as the confirmation step. Add a test that the RA trace shows at the fossa and changes to LA after crossing.

findings.problem: The plan's tip integration says 'low-act until ACT is in range'. The engine clears low-act once 70 U/kg or more has been given, even if no ACT has been measured, so the heparin tip disappears before the ACT is checked.
findings.fix: After entry to the left atrium, raise low-act unless the last measured ACT is at least TS_HEPARIN.actTargetS and was taken after the crossing: `if (laEntered(s) && !(last && last.s >= TS_HEPARIN.actTargetS && s.crossT !== null && last.t >= s.crossT)) add("low-act")`. Adjust the test at structuralTips.transseptal.test.ts:121 so it still measures the ACT, which it already does.

findings.problem: TransseptalControls keeps local state (hubLow, aspirate, leaveWire, triedNeedle). It is not reset when the host recreates tsState through 'Restart case' or the scenario menu while still on the transseptal step. A learner's 'hub held low' toggle carries into the next attempt, and 'Push harder' stays enabled.
findings.fix: Give the hosted controls a key: `<TransseptalControls key={runKey} ... />` in TeerLab. In LaaoLab, use its reset counter (or add one) as the key.

findings.problem: The alarm colouring thresholds are literals (hr < 50, map < 65, ST >= 1). They duplicate PATIENT_EVENT_THRESHOLDS without a source and can drift from it.
findings.fix: Import PATIENT_EVENT_THRESHOLDS from ../lab/patientEvents and use `.bradycardiaHr` and `.hypotensionMapMmHg`. Keep the 1 mm ST threshold commented as in patientVitals (ecg12.ts stemiCriteria).

findings.problem: 'Close the breach with an occluder' appears only when s.posteriorExit is true. This is hidden state, so the button's appearance after a pericardiocentesis tells the learner the bleed is a posterior exit and not an aortic or atrial-wall source.
findings.fix: Show the button whenever `s.cathetersOutT !== null && s.drains > 0 && !s.breachClosed`. In transseptalStep 'close-breach', when !s.posteriorExit, log 'No septal breach found on TOE.' and do nothing.

findings.problem: The drill title 'Changes on the monitor after crossing' appears in the scenario menu and the lesson practice list. It tells the learner a complication is coming, which breaks the file's own rule that 'the titles describe the patient, not the complication'.
findings.fix: Retitle it in both files to something patient-based, e.g. 'Routine TEER work-up, no previous surgery'. The launch test checks the ids, so they stay in sync.

fix.notes:
I applied findings 3 to 11. Three findings need files outside this package (see rejected), and two tests in another package's files still fail until finding 2 is applied.

Applied:
- **3, aortic crossing on TOE.** In src/simulation/transseptal.ts, cross() now clears the tent only when the needle enters the left atrium. In TransseptalStage.tsx the bicaval and short-axis views get `crossed` only for an LA crossing. In FossaPicker.tsx, ShortAxisView has a new `towardsAorta` prop that keeps the tent and draws the needle from it towards the aortic root. The crossed needles are tagged with `data-needle`. New engine and render tests cover this.
- **4, abandoned runs and the hosted debrief.** In TeerLab.tsx and LaaoLab.tsx a run stopped at the puncture now opens a 'Procedure stopped at the puncture' panel and TransseptalDebrief, scored by scoreTransseptal. It is logged once with passed false, devices [] and criticalErrors equal to the puncture's critical count plus 1 for a danger site. The device score, the device decisions (including LAAO release-criteria), the risk list, the compression table and the 'Released device' panel are skipped. Completed TEER and LAAO debriefs gain a 'Transseptal puncture' panel (new TransseptalSummary in TransseptalStage.tsx) with the puncture's deductions and critical errors. The site is passed as null there so it is not counted twice against scoreTeer or scoreLaao.

fix2.notes:
I applied 4 of the 6 findings. The other two (1 and 4) are confirmed but need files outside this package; see `rejected`. Tests and typecheck pass.

**Finding 2 (aortic crossing not penalised): applied.** Changes in `/Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/simulation/transseptal.ts`:
- **New state field:** `TsState.aorticCrossings` counts crossings into the aortic root. It starts at 0 and goes up by one in `cross()` when the needle enters the aorta.
- **Why a counter:** the existing check `needle === 'aorta'` resets when the needle is withdrawn. A withdraw-and-recross would then erase the mistake from the score.
- **Deduction:** `scoreTransseptal` takes 20 points (a model parameter, like the other deduction weights) when `aorticCrossings > 0`. The reason reads "Crossed where the aortic root lies against the fossa: read the short-axis view and move the tent posterior before crossing." It is skipped when the site was already deducted as a danger zone, so the same crossing is not penalised twice.
- **Ledger entry:** `transseptalDecisions` adds `ts-site-vs-aorta` (lesson CROSS, tip `structural-ts-aortic-puncture-hold`). It is correct only when `aorticCrossings === 0`. It is added when the aorta was entered, or when the variant has a root closer to the fossa than the default (`aorticAp < BASE_VARIANT.aorticAp`) and a crossing was made.
- **Effect on the drill:** ts-aortic-puncture, crossed at the anterior fossa and then handled correctly (trace read as aortic, surgeon called), now scores below 100 and shows the decision as wrong.

**Finding 3 (LAO check gave no visible result): applied.**
- **Engine:** `check-lao` now logs a neutral line, "LAO projection: wire and leads on screen." It says nothing about whether the wire is anterior or posterior.
- **Image:** in `/Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/ui/structural/TransseptalStage.tsx`, the fluoroscopy component counts those log lines. Each new check switches the image to LAO while the stage is at setup. The Show AP / Show LAO link still overrides the view until the next check.
- **No host changes:** this keeps the change inside the stage file, so TeerLab and LaaoLab did not need edits.

**Finding 5 (chosen trace reading not shown): applied.**

- **Change:** the four reading buttons are now ordinary buttons like the confirmation buttons. The chosen one gets the accent style, a ✓ prefix and `aria-pressed`. Only the learner's own reading is marked; the stage still never says which trace it is.

**Finding 6 (aria-label wrong with the needle in the aorta): applied.** After crossing, the fluoroscopy aria-label now reads "advanced beyond the tent at the fossa" and no longer names a chamber.
